Around [[3626 BBY]], a [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] worked as the '''bartender''' of the [[Shining Star cantina]] on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. She assisted an individual with tracking a [[Nexu claw pendant]] belonging to her favorite [[Swoop gang/Legends|swoop gang]], the [[Horizon's Razor]].
